Rhea.AE: New POC with AzureWave (enterprise fintech). They want to run azurewave-34b in their colo with KV prefix caching, BYO HSM (PKCS#11), and ~10 qps sustained. Need model-variant compatibility notes, rough onboarding timeline, and ballpark pricing for Dedicated vs Private. Any immediate blockers?

Cal.SE: Quick callout: azurewave-34b upstream uses RMSNorm + grouped_gemm and a custom rotary scale. We have working q8_0 quant path but grouped_gemm needs the runtime kernel patch for good perf. Without it quantized latency may be higher.

Imran.ML: On model work: export + quantize + compile + basic perf = ~3 business days if runtime can accept kernel patch/container with patched runtime. KV prefix caching supported up to ~2k tokens by default. If they need >2k prefixes, we should plan kv-shard or prefix-slicing (+1 day). We can also offer azurewave-lite (~16B distilled) for cost-sensitive POCs.

Talia.Infra: On-prem checklist: NVIDIA driver >=525, CUDA >=12.1, container runtime >=1.6, and PKCS#11 libs. Ask for `nvidia-smi` and `ldconfig -p` output. If air-gapped, we can provide image tarball but that adds ~1 day and requires signed manifests. I'll open an infra validation ticket.

Jae.Security: BYO HSM via PKCS#11 is supported in Private with our KMS shim. Required docs: security questionnaire, network/dataflow diagram, signed DPA, and SOC2 Type II. If they require zero-egress model residency, we'll need to validate image delivery and disable outbound telemetry; that'll be an SOW addendum.

infra-bot: INF-20011 created: customer preflight commands:
```
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,name --format=csv
./validate_cuda.sh --min-version=12.1
ldconfig -p | grep -i pkcs11 || echo "pkcs11 missing"
```

Cal.SE: Cost note: hosted-equivalent 4x H100s ~ $430/hr platform (ballpark). Private adds platform license + ops retainer for 24/7. I'll produce a 10 qps calc for Dedicated vs Private (include azurewave-lite option).

Imran.ML: Timeline: 3 days conversion + 1 day KV tuning + 1 day integration/docs + 1-2 days canary = ~6-7 business days after infra greenlight. If runtime recompile required on-prem add 1 day.

Rhea.AE: Action items: I'll request env dump and the filled security RFI. Cal please draft cost/SOW with both Dedicated and Private numbers and include attestation language for model residency. Imran tentatively reserve conversion days. Talia open infra ticket and wait for `nvidia-smi` output. Jae I'll DM the RFI template. Thanks :thumbsup:"
